| Search | `GET /v1/youtube/search` | 1 credit per successful request (a profile, a post, one page of a list) |
| Search inside a YouTube channel | `GET /v1/youtube/channel/search` | 1 credit per successful request (a profile, a post, one page of a list) |
| Search suggestions | `GET /v1/youtube/search/typeahead` | 1 credit per successful request (a profile, a post, one page of a list) |
| Trending YouTube Shorts | `GET /v1/youtube/shorts/trending` | 1 credit per successful request (a profile, a post, one page of a list) |
| Video comments | `GET /v1/youtube/video/comments` | 1 credit per successful request (a profile, a post, one page of a list) |
| Video or Short details | `GET /v1/youtube/video` | 1 credit per successful request (a profile, a post, one page of a list) |
| Video sponsors | `GET /v1/youtube/video/sponsors` | 1 credit per successful request (a profile, a post, one page of a list) |
| Video transcript | `GET /v1/youtube/video/transcript` | 1 credit for captions; AI transcription 1 up to 2 minutes, then 5 per started minute of the whole video |
| Videos by hashtag | `GET /v1/youtube/search/hashtag` | 1 credit per successful request (a profile, a post, one page of a list) |
